candidates.change_summary: Change return true to return false so the return value differs from the original when the call succeeds.

Change the require check for v[i] validity so that multiplication uses 10**18 instead of 1000000000000000000, but the actual call argument still uses 1000000000000000000, causing different revert behavior for edge cases.
Remove the require that validates v[i] multiplicative correctness, allowing overflow-prone multiplications to proceed to the call.
Delete the entire for-loop body, causing no calls to be made and thus transfer always returns true with no state changes.
